title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Maneuver: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.
lore: ...One Ring to find them....
subtitle: Such a Weight to Carry

title: Battle Tested
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (+4 if you spot a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition).
lore: 'We're going to follow you, lad – even on the dark Road....'

title: Calculated Risk
gametext: Spot a Dwarf and add a threat to draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Beyond the eyes of Dwarves are such fortellings....'

title: Dark Ways
gametext:
To play, spot a Dwarf.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to heal a Dwarf twice and take a [dwarven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you have initiative, Gimli is strength +2.
lore: 'I will go with you even on the Paths of the Dead, and to whatever end they may lead....'
subtitle: Faithful Companion

title: Gimli
gametext:
Damage +1.
Response: If a [dwarven] condition is about to be discarded by an opponent, exert a Dwarf or discard a [dwarven] card from hand to prevent that.
lore: 'There are countless things still to see in Middle-earth, and great works to do.'
subtitle: Feared Axeman

title: Gimli's Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be Gimli.
Response: If you have initiative and Gimli is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
lore: 'I hope that the forgotten people will not have forgotten how to fight....'

title: Gimli's Battle Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
While you can spot a threat, bearer is damage +1.
While you can spot 2 threats, bearer is strength +1.
While you can spot 3 threats, the fellowship archery total is +1.
subtitle: Trusted Weapon

title: Loyalty Unshaken
gametext:
When you play this condition, you may stack 2 cards from hand here and draw a card for each [dwarven] card you stack.
Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Also, make that Dwarf damage +2 for each [dwarven] card stacked on this condition. Discard this condition.

title: Out of Darkness
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2. You may also exert that Dwarf to draw 2 cards.
lore: 'Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'

true.text: Would you like to exert {chosenDwarf} to draw 2 cards?

title: Preparations
gametext:
Regroup: Exert a Dwarf companion to stack a card from your discard pile here.
Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing a Dwarf once for each [dwarven] card stacked here. Discard this condition.

title: Reckless Pride
gametext:
Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride."
Regroup: Discard this condition to draw 4 cards.

modifier.text: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride.

title: Slaked Thirsts
gametext: Choose one: Spot a Dwarf to draw a card; or, if this card is stacked on a [dwarven] condition, spot a Dwarf companion and discard this event to exert a minion twice.
lore: 'Food and drink would pay off some of my score against you.'

title: Ancient Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be an [elven] companion.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Ancient Blade."
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and reconcile your hand.

modifier.text: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride.

title: Arwen
gametext: While skirmishing a fierce minion, Arwen is strength +3.
lore: 'But she also sends word to you... Fair well, Elfstone!'
subtitle: Fair Elf Maiden

title: Asfaloth
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Skirmish: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to make each minion skirmishing her strength -2.
subtitle: Elven Steed

title: Bow of the Galadhrim
gametext:
Bearer must be Legolas.
Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event during a skirmish involving Legolas, you may heal him.
subtitle: Gift of Galadriel

title: Careful Study
gametext: Spot an Elf and discard 3 cards from hand to reconcile your hand.
lore: 'If thou art in haste, remember the Paths of the Dead.'

title: Defiance
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgûl).

title: Elrond
gametext:
To play, spot Aragorn or an Elf.
At the start of each turn, you may exert Elrond to heal a character bearing an artifact.
lore: 'Onen i-estel Edain.'
subtitle: Elven Lord

title: Hope Comes
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Elves.
Response: If an [elven] skirmish event is played, discard this condition to draw 3 cards.
lore: 'Either our hope cometh, or all hopes end.'

title: Into the West
gametext: Regroup: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, remove 3 threats. Place the revealed card beneath your draw deck.
lore: 'The days are now short.'

title: Leaving Forever
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a condition or draw 2 cards.
lore: 'Then I thought in my heart that we drew near to the sea....'

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
Archery: If you have initiative, discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion.
lore: 'I also will come... for I do not fear the Dead.'
subtitle: Fearless Marksman

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer.
Archery: If you cannot spot a threat, add a threat to make the fellowship archery total +1.
lore: 'Alas for the wailing of the gulls! Did not the Lady tell me to beware of them?'
subtitle: Nimble Warrior

title: Mirkwood Bowman
gametext: Exert 2 [elven] companions to discard the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Make the fellowship archery total +1 for each [elven] card discarded.
lore: 'Thus we passed over Gilrain, driving the allies of Mordor in rout before us....'

title: Shadow Between
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard this condition or a card from hand to heal an Elf.
lore: 'But did I not also fortell that you shall neither have wife, nor bind any woman to you....'

title: Still Needed
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2. You may place this event on top of your draw deck.
lore: 'You must not go to the Havens Legolas. There will always be some folk... who need you.'

effect.text: Would you like to put this event on top of your draw deck?

title: Uncertain Paths
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 and you may shuffle your draw deck.
lore: 'But defenders and foes alike gave up the battle....'

effect.text: Would you like to shuffle your draw deck?

title: All Save One
gametext: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if you have initiative).
lore: 'You cannot enter here....'

title: The Board Is Set
gametext:
Spell.
If an event is played, exert Gandalf to make that opponent remove (2) or cancel that event.
lore: 'We come to it at last... the greatest battle of our time.'

title: Citadel to Gate
gametext: Exert Gandalf twice to remove all threats and to heal all companions of one culture (except [gandalf]).
lore: Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.

effect.text: Choose companion of the culture you wish to heal

title: Echoes of Valinor
gametext: Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may exert him to draw 2 cards.
lore: 'Here in the Court of the Kings, Isildur grew a white tree, from a seed brought over the waters....'

title: Fool's Hope
gametext: Spot Gandalf and discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent discard all but 2 Shadow conditions.
lore: 'There never was much hope....'

effect.text: Choose Shadow conditions to spare, all others will be discarded

title: Gandalf
gametext: While you cannot spot 3 companions of the same culture, Gandalf is strength -2.
lore: 'I come with counsel and tidings in this dark hour.'
subtitle: Defender of the West

title: Gandalf
gametext: Skirmish: Place 3 cards from hand on top of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -3. Any Shadow player may place 3 cards from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck to prevent this.

effect.text: Would you like to place 3 cards from your hand on top of your deck to prevent Gandalf's effect?

subtitle: Manager of Wizards

title: Gandalf's Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
While you can spot 4 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +1.
lore: 'But for Gandalf Stormcrow you would have seen a host of foes coming out of Anórien....'
subtitle: Focus of Power

title: Glamdring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
He is damage +1.
Skirmish: If you have more cards in hand than each opponent, discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent exert a minion.
subtitle: Elven Blade

title: Have Patience
gametext: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

title: Intimidate
gametext:
Spell.
If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

title: King's Advisor
gametext: Exert Gandalf twice to make an opponent exert a minion for each [rohan] companion you spot.
lore: 'Will they answer the summons, think you?'

title: Light the Beacons
gametext: Exert Gandalf three times (or twice if you have initiative) to make all unbound companions of one culture (except [gandalf]) strength +3 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'Théoden will honour your old alliance and come with a mighty army.'

effect.text: Choose companion of the culture you want to give strength +3 to

title: Moment of Respite
gametext: At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to heal Gandalf.
lore: '...Gandalf says you must go ere nightfall, and the Lord of the Mark is eager for his own house.'

title: Númenor's Pride
gametext:
To play, spot Gandalf and add 3 threats.
Gandalf is defender +1 and cannot take wounds.
Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

title: Peace of Mind
gametext: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound Hobbit 3 times.
lore: 'All Wizards should have a Hobbit or two in their care... to teach them the meaning of humility!'

title: Sharpen Your Swords
gametext: Spot Gandalf to make a [gondor] companion strength +1 for each [gondor] companion you spot (limit +4).
lore: 'Courage will now be your best defence against the storm that is at hand....'

effect.text: Choose how many {gondor} companions to spot

title: Stay This Madness
gametext:
To play, spot Gandalf.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to wound 2 minions.
lore: So it was that Gandalf took command of the last defence of the City of Gondor.

title: Steadfast Champion
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to Gandalf."
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

modifier.text: Assign this minion to bearer of Steadfast Champion.

title: Terrible and Evil
gametext:
Spell.
Exert Gandalf X times to wound a minion X times. If that minion is a Nazgûl, wound it again.
lore: 'Minas Morgul is their lair.'

cost.text: Choose how many times you wish to exert Gandalf

title: Undaunted
gametext: Exert Gandalf to make him strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +8).
lore: '...here the hammerstroke will fall hardest....'

title: Wizard Staff
gametext:
Bearer must be a Wizard.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.

title: Captured by the Ring
gametext: Play Gollum from your draw deck or discard pile to add a threat.
lore: 'Give us that....'

texts: Play Gollum from your draw deck

title: Clever Hobbits
gametext: Discard any number of [gollum] conditions. For each condition discarded, make Sméagol strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: 'Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'

title: Days Growing Dark
gametext: Fellowship: Discard 3 cards from hand to play Sméagol from your discard pile.
lore: 'Come on, we must go, no time to lose!'

title: The Dead City
gametext:
Stealth.
Bearer must be Sméagol.
If Sméagol is about to be killed in a skirmish, he is discarded instead.
lore: 'Not that way!'

title: Fat One Wants It
gametext:
Each time Gollum or Sméagol is played, add a threat.
Regroup: Discard this condition to return Gollum to his owner's hand.

title: Gollum
gametext: If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this minion from your discard pile.
lore: 'Let Her deal with them... she must eat. All She gets is filthy Orcses.'
subtitle: Plotting Deceiver

title: Gollum
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice or remove a threat to make him strength +2.
lore: When they come to the bridge they will see us. Come away! Climb, climb!
subtitle: Vile Creature

title: Heavy Burden
gametext: Regroup: Discard Gollum and remove a threat to add a burden.
lore: 'Sméagol knows... Sméagol carried burden many years.'

title: Hobbitses Are Dead
gametext:
Spot Gollum or Sméagol to make a Nazgûl, [sauron] minion, or [gollum] minion strength +2.
If you have initiative, you may play this event from your discard pile; place it under your draw deck instead of discarding it.

title: It's Mine
gametext: Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Gollum to discard the top card of your draw deck. If that card is a [gollum] or [wraith] card, take it into hand.
lore: 'See! See! He wants it for himself.'

title: Let Her Deal With Them
gametext:
To play, spot Gollum or Sméagol. Bearer must be a minion. Limit 1 per bearer.
Bearer is damage +1.
If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this condition from your discard pile.

title: Nasty
gametext: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each [gollum] card you spot.
lore: 'He's a fat, horrid Hobbit, who hates Sméagol, who makes up nasty lies.'

effect.text: Choose how many {gollum} cards you want to spot

title: Never
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Regroup: Discard Sméagol to remove 2 threats.
lore: 'Sméagol wouldn't hurt a fly!'

title: No Safe Places
gametext: Exert Sméagol to reveal an opponent's hand. That opponent must discard a card from hand for each culture revealed.
lore: '...they are watching... eyes will see us.'

title: Plotting
gametext:
To play, spot Gollum and add up to 9 threats.
Gollum is strength +2.
Discard this condition and remove 9 threats at the start of the regroup phase.
lore: 'We shall see... Oh yes, we shall see!'

title: Scouting
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Maneuver: Discard Sméagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.

effect.text: Would you like to exert a minion twice to prevent Free People player discarding a minion?

title: Secret Paths
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol and add 2 threats.
The move limit for this turn is +1.
Discard this condition at the end of the turn.
lore: 'Not that way! No, not that way!'

title: Serving the Precious
gametext: Discard Sméagol to play a companion from your discard pile.
lore: 'Sméagol look after Master. Sméagol serve Master well!'

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Assignment: Assign a minion to Sméagol and add 2 threats to exhaust that minion.
lore: 'Yes, yes! Sméagol helps, always helps.'

cost.text: Choose a minion for Smeagol to skirmish and exhaust.

subtitle: Always Helps

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from your hand. Sméagol cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lore: 'Wake up! Wake up! Wake up, sleepies! We must go, yes, we must go at once!'
subtitle: Hurried Guide

title: Sneaking!
gametext:
Stealth.
Heal Sméagol (or cancel Sméagol's skirmish if he has more vitality than the minion or minions he is skirmishing).
lore: 'What were you doing?'

title: So Polite
gametext: Play Gollum from your discard pile to add (1) for each threat you spot.
lore: 'Sméagol shows them secret ways that nobody else could find and they say, 'Sneak!''

title: Sweeter Meats
gametext: If a minion is about to take a wound, spot Gollum to prevent that wound.
lore: 'It may well be, oh yes, it may very well be, that when She throws away the bones and the empty clothes... we shall find It!'

title: Very Nice Friends
gametext: Play Sméagol from your discard pile to play the fellowship's next site (replacing an opponent's site if necessary). If you do not move again this turn, discard your hand.
lore: 'He hurts us... hurts poor Sméagol!'

title: We Hates Them
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to Sméagol."
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and play a companion from your discard pile.

modifier.text: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride.

title: Where Shall We Go
gametext: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a minion Sméagol is skirmishing twice.
lore: 'If you scare him off, we are lost.'

title: Andúril
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn. Discard other weapons he bears. He is damage +1 and cannot bear other weapons.
Fellowship or Regroup: If the fellowship is at any site 2 or any site 5, play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).
subtitle: Flame of the West

title: Andúril
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
If you cannot spot a threat, Aragorn is defender +1.
lore: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... for Aragorn son of Arathorn was going to war upon the marches of Mordor.
subtitle: King's Blade

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Knight.
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to heal another [gondor] companion.
lore: '...but one who can wield the power this sword commands....'
subtitle: Captain of Gondor

title: Cirion
gametext: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2.
lore: So now at last the City was besieged....

title: City of Men
gametext: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2. If that Man is skirmishing a [sauron] minion, discard that minion at the end of the skirmish.
lore: 'I will gladly give my life to defend her beauty, her memory... her wisdom.'

title: Dagger Strike
gametext: Make a [gondor] or [shire] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.

title: Denethor
gametext:
Fellowship: Play a [gondor] knight. That knight's twilight cost is -2.
Each time a Shadow card adds a threat, add a burden. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, add a threat.
lore: A pale smile, like a gleam of cold sun on a winter's evening, passed over the old man's face....
subtitle: Steward of the City

title: Denethor
gametext: Denethor is strength +1 for each other [gondor] Man you can spot (limit +4).
lore: '...in desperate hours gentleness may be repaid with death.'
subtitle: Wizened Steward

title: Derufin
gametext: Regroup: While you have exactly 5 cards in hand, you may exert Derufin to discard an engine, machine, or possession.
lore: From the uplands of Morthond....

title: Dervorin
gametext: At the start of the regroup phase, if you have only 4 cards in hand, you may spot another [gondor] Man to discard a minion.
lore: The men of Ringló Vale behind the son of their lord....

title: Duty of Two
gametext: Add 3 threats to heal all [gondor] companions.
lore: '...for himself, and for the one that will not return.'

title: Faramir
gametext:
Ranger. To play, spot a [gondor] Man.
Each time Faramir wins a skirmish involving a fierce minion, you may exert Faramir to discard that minion.
lore: 'But if I should return, think better of me!'
subtitle: Stout Captain

title: Faramir
gametext:
Ranger.
Fellowship: Play a [rohan] Man to heal Faramir.
Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to prevent all wounds to Faramir.

effects.text: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2
Exert Gandalf to prevent all wounds to Faramir

subtitle: Wizard's Pupil

title: First Level
gametext:
Fortification.
Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot a knight to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.
lore: ...the walls passed from looming white to grey....

title: Footman's Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Response: If bearer is about to be overwhelmed, discard a [gondor] fortification or a card from hand to make bearer strength +2.

title: Gondor Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
If bearer is a knight, he or she is strength +1.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound a minion he or she is skirmishing if that minion bears a fortification.
lore: ...tall Duinhir with his sons, Duilin and Derufin, and five hundred bowmen.

title: Gondor Still Stands
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions.
While no opponent controls a site, wound a minion at the start of each regroup phase.
Regroup: Discard this condition to place a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

title: Gondorian Captain
gametext:
Knight.
Fellowship: Discard a fortification to remove a threat.
lore: 'The Captains of the Outlands are expected up the South Road ere sundown.'

title: Gondorian Merchant
gametext: Maneuver: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to make the site number of a minion +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: ...they talked now of Gondor and its ways and customs....

title: Gondorian Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make bearer damage +1.

title: Great Gate
gametext: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 and, if you can spot 2 [gondor] fortifications, exert a minion that companion is skirmishing.
lore: ...and its iron doors rolled back before them.

title: Greatest Stronghold
gametext: Exert a [gondor] Man and spot 3 fortifications to make the fellowship archery total +2.
lore: '...City of Kings of yore.'

title: Guarded
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gondor] Men.
Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.
Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion (or all roaming minions).

title: Hasty Repairs
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gondor] Men.
Regroup: While you have only 4 cards in hand, you may discard 2 cards from hand to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile.
lore: 'The work will be finished ere evening...'

title: Hearts Raised
gametext: At the start of your regroup phase, you may spot a [gondor] Man and discard a card from hand to remove a threat.
lore: ...lifted for a while by the return of Faramir....

title: Hidden Knowledge
gametext: Spot a [gondor] companion to reveal the top 5 cards of an opponent's draw deck. For each Shadow card revealed, add a threat. For each Free Peoples card revealed, place a [gondor] token on one of your conditions with a [gondor] token on it. Shuffle that draw deck.

title: I Will Go
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
If you have initiative, bearer is defender +1.
lore: 'I do command it.'

title: Ingold
gametext:
Knight.
Fellowship: Discard a fortification to heal Ingold twice.
lore: 'Do you know aught of them? Will they answer the summons, think you?'

title: Iorlas
gametext: Response: If a possession or engine is played by your opponent, remove a [gondor] token from your condition to make that opponent remove (1). If he or she cannot, discard that possession or engine.

title: Knight's Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to make bearer strength +1.

title: Long Prepared
gametext:
To play, add 2 threats.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a roaming minion that Man is skirmishing.
Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.
lore: 'For myself, I have long known....'

title: Madril
gametext:
Ranger.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a roaming minion Madril is skirmishing.
lore: 'I have sent the company of Ithilien to strengthen it....'
subtitle: Faramir's Aide

title: Man the Walls
gametext: The site number of each minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man is +1.
lore: '...their force was too weak to make any stroke of war on their own part....'

title: Noble Leaders
gametext:
When you play this condition, place a [gondor] token here for each of the following characters you can spot: Aragorn, Boromir, Denethor or Faramir.
Skirmish: Remove a token from here or discard this condition to make a [gondor] companion strength +1 and damage +1.

title: Pippin's Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be Pippin.
While you can spot 3 [gondor] Men, Pippin may take no more than 1 wound in a skirmish.
lore: 'Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor....'

title: Pippin's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be Pippin.
Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice make him strength +1 for each [gondor] companion you spot.
lore: The old man laid the sword along his lap, and Pippin put his hand to the hilt....

effect.text: Choose how many {gondor} companions to spot

title: Ranger of Minas Tirith
gametext:
Ranger.
While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: And upon its out-thrust knee was the Guarded City, with its seven walls of stone....

title: Ranger of Osgiliath
gametext:
Ranger.

title: Morgul Vale
gametext: Skirmish: Spot your [sauron] minion and remove 2 threats to make your [sauron] minion strength +3.

title: Morgulduin
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile. His twilight cost is -2.

title: Northern Ithilien
gametext: Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens.

title: Dagorlad

title: Haunted Pass
gametext: Shadow: Remove a threat and spot your minion to draw a card.

title: Narchost
gametext: Shadow: Spot 8 burdens to make the Ring-bearer wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

title: Slag Mounds
gametext: Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
While you cannot spot 4 threats, Aragorn is strength +1 for each threat.
Regroup: Exert Aragorn twice to remove 3 threats.
lore: '...for you will find both toil and great fear, and maybe worse.'

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 3 cards from hand to make Éomer strength +1 for each valiant companion you spot.
